name: Hentai Literature Club
source:
A hentai parody made by a DDLC fan to DDLC fans using DDLC's and Team Salvato's characters and illusion Koikatsu game and software! 

[From Patreon]
translation:
由一名《心跳文学部》（DDLC）粉丝专为同好们打造的色情恶搞同人游戏，采用了《心跳文学部》及Team Salvato旗下的角色设定，并借助ILLUSION的《恋活！》游戏与工作室软件制作而成！

[摘自Patreon]
